name: OmniRoute for LearnHarness
description: Routes LearnHarness's agents through OmniRoute and shows OmniRoute's data in the app. Can install, start and stop OmniRoute for you. Needs one manual step: in Settings → Providers → Custom endpoint, set LearnHarness's models to the OmniRoute-* combos (the plugin cannot change LearnHarness settings).
